about.description: KW is a tokenized tracker certificate issued by Robinhood Markets, Inc. through Robinhood Europe UAB, deployed on Arbitrum One. It is designed to reflect the price of the KW ETF in a format accessible on-chain, providing synthetic exposure rather than direct fund ownership under MiFID II regulatory oversight. Trading is available 24/5 to EU/EEA customers, and on-chain pricing is supplied through Chainlink oracle feeds.
